title: Creating a hardware stack to support Generative Gaming
author: Lumpy_Conference6640
selftext:
Hi everyone, 

I'm exploring making a mobile hardware stack for portable generative AI gaming. Its mostly a fantasy of trying to support my own games, but I thought, what if there was a true platform to support the community, with specs, pipeline, and everything.

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: This seems pretty vague, can you be more specific? When you say hardware stack or you planning to release a phone or something?

replies.author: Lumpy_Conference6640
replies.body:
It's pretty nebulous idea at the moment. I know some hardware vendors and I've done a fair bit with Android even at the deep machine level. 

My goal would be a lighter more affordable version of a steam deck. Something with enough RAM to run localized AI systems support for python with maybe a monorepo of three.js and WebGPU. 

Probably Linux based, for react based programs since AI tends towards that.

replies.author: theweeJoe
replies.body:
There are lots of fairly well specc'd, low (relatively) cost handhelds that run android and Linux and allow you to boot your own os. I'm not sure what the minimum specs are these days for some modest opensource models which would run on the handheld specs, that's your job. Maybe some allow ram expansion which might help. 

Either way when you find a compatible handheld you could try boot your own os or software stack in Linux. Let me know if you need any more information but you would need to provide more info also on exactly what kind of generative content and what purpose generating locally looks like or achieves

replies.author: Lumpy_Conference6640
replies.body: There are plenty of units running Android or Linux, but they're all hardcoded against root access, so the games are locked in, which isn't really viable.

replies.author: theweeJoe
replies.body: Look up strix halo linux llm projects, there are people doing this kind of stuff on handheld. You want to use an agent on your handheld but don't know to ask it how to do this??

replies.author: Lumpy_Conference6640
replies.body:
You guys really aren't getting it and I'm not explaining it well.
